title: Understanding the Code
text:
The code `consoles.groupby('generation').size().loc[7]` is used to find the number of consoles in the seventh generation. Let's break it down:

$$1$$. **`consoles.groupby('generation')`**: This groups the DataFrame by the 'generation' column.
$$2$$. **`.size()`**: This returns the size of each group, i.e., the number of entries in each generation.
$$3$$. **`.loc[7]`**: This selects the size of the group corresponding to generation $$7$$.
